cardinality.rule: utilities.genericViewportDisplaySetMetadataProvider: the file does not bind utilities; if it is Cornerstone's, its name in 6.0 is displaySetRegistry, a top-level export
viewportProjection.getPresentation: the file does not bind viewportProjection; if it is Cornerstone's, its name in 6.0 is getFraming

Enums.Events.VOI_MODIFIED: the file does not bind Enums; if it is Cornerstone's, its name in 6.0 is DISPLAY_SET_APPEARANCE_CHANGED; DISPLAY_SET_APPEARANCE_CHANGED fires once for every change of the appearance of a display set, also at its mount and when a scroll shows an image with another default window: test detail.cause and detail.changedKeys; the window is detail.effective.voiRange, the colormap detail.effective.colormap, what a caller set detail.overrides
